shared_elements: a single figure shown in profile
scaly/feathered surface rendered as rows of overlapping imbricated scallops
a hybrid or animal-attribute being (fish-cloaked man / raptor-headed body)
strong profile orientation with head turned to one side
justification: Both depict a single profile figure whose body surface is covered with regular rows of overlapping scale-or-feather scallops, rendered in a stylised repetitive convention, and both involve a non-human/hybrid creature. But A is an upright anthropomorphic figure with human legs, arm raised, holding a bucket-like handled vessel and wearing a fish skin, while B is a squatting bird of prey with hooked beak and folded wings and no attributes or attendant elements at all.
